title: HTTPRequest sometimes repeatedly gets connection error (HTTPRequest.RESULT_CONNECTION_ERROR) until restart.
body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.4.beta3 and several earlier versions, going back as far as 4.2 (untested prior to that).

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta3 - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6603) - AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads)

### Issue description

I'm working on a twitch client, and every so often, tokens need to be refreshed, but every once in a while, the refresh will fail to connect.  Once this starts happening, it repeatedly fails for many hours.  Sometimes it will eventually reconnect on its own, but usually it won't reconnect until the application is restarted, then there are no connection errors.

My guess is there's some internal state that's not cleared properly.  I'm creating a completely new HTTPRequest, so it's not like there's something due to recycling that.  I'm connecting to the same URL after restarting, so I don't think it's something on Twitch's end.  Somebody recently fixed something with the connection status on HTTPRequest, and I hoped it would fix this issue as well, but apparently it did not.

### Steps to reproduce

I haven't found a consistent repro case.  It seems to just sometimes happen when connecting to "https://id.twitch.tv/oauth2/token".  I was going to wait until I could figure out a consistent way to make it happen, but I figured I'd just go ahead and create the issue now and try to investigate more later.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I don't have a consistent MRP to really dial this in as it happens very rarely (maybe once every few weeks of daily use).  Here's the function I'm using, based off a modified GIFT addon:

```gdscript

func refresh_token(scope_type : ScopeType) -> RefreshTokenResult:
	print("refresh_token(%d)" % scope_type)
	var request : HTTPRequest = HTTPRequest.new()
	add_child(request)
	var refresh_token : String
	
	if (scope_type == ScopeType.SCOPE_TYPE_USER):
		refresh_token = token_user["refresh_token"]
	elif (scope_type == ScopeType.SCOPE_TYPE_CHANNEL):
		refresh_token = token_channel["refresh_token"]
	request.request("https://id.twitch.tv/oauth2/token", [USER_AGENT, "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded"], HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, str("client_id=", client_id, "&client_secret=", client_secret, "&refresh_token=", refresh_token, "&grant_type=refresh_token"))
	var reply : Array = await(request.request_completed)
	request.queue_free()
	var request_result = reply[0]
	if (reply[0] != HTTPRequest.RESULT_SUCCESS):
		if (reply[0] == HTTPRequest.RESULT_CONNECTION_ERROR):
			print_chat_window(str("Error refreshing token ", scope_type, ". Connection error."))
		elif (reply[0] == HTTPRequest.RESULT_CANT_CONNECT):
			print_chat_window(str("Error refreshing token ", scope_type, ". Can't connect."))
		else:
			print_chat_window(str("Error refreshing token ", scope_type, ": ", reply[0]))
		had_refresh_error = true
		return RefreshTokenResult.CONNECTION_ERROR
	var response_string : String = reply[3].get_string_from_utf8()
	if (reply[1] != 200):
		print_chat_window(str("Error refreshing token.  Code ", reply[1], " ", response_string))
		had_refresh_error = true
		return RefreshTokenResult.RESPONSE_ERROR
	var response = JSON.parse_string(response_string)
	if (!response):
		print_chat_window(str("Error refreshing token -- non-json response: ", response_string))
		#get_token(scope_type)
		had_refresh_error = true
		return RefreshTokenResult.NULL_RESPONSE
	elif (response.has("error")):
		var response_error = response["error"]
		var response_status = response["status"]
		print_chat_window(str("Error refreshing token: ", response_status, " ", response_error))
		#get_token(scope_type)
		had_refresh_error = true
		return RefreshTokenResult.RESPONSE_ERROR
	var token_dict := process_token_data(reply[3].get_string_from_utf8(), scope_type)
	if (scope_type == ScopeType.SCOPE_TYPE_CHANNEL):
		token_channel = token_dict
	if (scope_type == ScopeType.SCOPE_TYPE_USER):
		token_user = token_dict
	if (had_refresh_error):
		print_chat_window(str("Token ", scope_type, " refreshed."))
		had_refresh_error = false
	return RefreshTokenResult.SUCCESS
```
